description: `start <name>` on a project with no open workspace creates one, writes the Nexus seed, and launches the configured interactive seat: workspace_list/pane_list/agent_list (roster fetched because an interactive seat is configured), then a second workspace_list/pane_list/agent_list taken under the per-project lock (cli.cmd_start / card 20261022-b-c62a28 finding 1; the under-lock agent_list is critic-safety.md#8's fix — the duplicate-Nexus lease check must read the listing taken under the lock, not the pre-lock roster) before workspace create, pane run, agent list (readiness poll), agent rename, agent read (dialog probe), agent get (baseline), agent prompt, agent get (landing confirmation) — matching cli.cmd_start's transcript for the cutover path (workspaces do not survive a Herdr restart, so every project reopens via this exact path). Exit EXIT_OK (0).

home.config_toml:
[accounts.nexus-seat]
kind = "claude"
config_dir_var = "CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR"
config_dir = "{{DIR:claude-home}}"
pool = "claude:test"
interactive = true
command = "claude-interactive"

[accounts.worker]
kind = "codex"
config_dir_var = "CODEX_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:codex-home}}"
pool = "codex:test"
command = "codex"

[projects.sandbox]
path = "{{PROJECT:sandbox}}"

[projects.sandbox.chains]
explorer = ["worker"]
fixer = ["worker"]
reviewer = ["worker"]

match_argv: Read `{{PROJECT:sandbox}}/.multiverse/orchestrator.md` now and follow it. You are the Nexus for sandbox. Read the project's handoff card and resume its history. Report, in two lines, which repository you own and which roles you may route.

.multiverse/orchestrator.md.regex: \| Builder \| worker \|[\s\S]*\| Critic \| worker \|[\s\S]*\| Scout \| worker \|[\s\S]*- Cross-vendor review required for:
